changes: Fixes [#662](https://github.com/repeat98/modwerk/issues/662): with Euclidean open, TRIG, SRC, FLTR, AMP and LFO now leave it for that page, as from any parameter page. Before, only NO closed it.

FUNC + TRIG, FLTR, AMP or LFO now opens Quantize, Delay, Reverb or Compressor from Euclidean. Before, FUNC + FLTR and FUNC + LFO changed the header while the Euclidean controls stayed on screen. FUNC + SRC has no native action and keeps Euclidean open.
Tested by the author on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, with all six mods and alone, including project save/reload and a power cycle (under 30 minutes). Emulator page-key regression on both OSes.

First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track. Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
